devices.label: Raspberry Pi 2
devices.reason: INFEASIBLE: 32-bit ARMv7 — the whole rpi5 toolchain is aarch64-only (#351 verdict)

devices.label: "Raspberry Pi 6"
devices.reason: DOES NOT EXIST — the latest shipping Raspberry Pi is the Pi 5 (#351 verdict); listed so the request dies honestly

devices.label: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
devices.reason: 512MB RAM is below even the Pi 3 desktop-only floor — no builder role fits (the node stack needs >1GB, the desktop needs >=1GB)

devices.label: Orange Pi 2
devices.reason: INFEASIBLE: 32-bit ARMv7 — the aarch64-only toolchain blocker (#351 verdict)

devices.label: Orange Pi 3 (non-LTS)
devices.reason: the LTS revision now has its own platform (orangepi3-lts / specs-orangepi3-lts, which ironically boots THIS board's own mainline DTB/defconfig — mainline has no -lts variant), so promoting the non-LTS board is a validation task, not a builder task — but its board row (AP6256 radio, 1/2GB RAM SKUs, PCIe) is unverified against that recipe and is not claimed until a real board proves it (#351 honesty rule)

devices.label: Orange Pi 4
devices.reason: the LTS revision now has its own platform (orangepi4-lts / specs-orangepi4-lts, which boots THIS board's own mainline DTB and U-Boot defconfig — mainline has no -lts variant of either), so promoting the non-LTS board is a validation task, not a builder task. Its board row (no onboard eMMC, differing RAM SKUs) is unverified against that recipe and is not claimed until a real board proves it (#351 honesty rule)

devices.label: Orange Pi 4 Pro
devices.reason: UNCONFIRMED SKU — folds into the Orange Pi 4 verdict only IF proven RK3399 (#351). If proven, it would ride the orangepi4-lts platform rather than needing a new builder

devices.label: Orange Pi 5 Pro
devices.reason: RK3588S variant with newer LPDDR5/boot bits; the board row is unverified against the opi5 recipe — a promotion path exists (opi5 board axis + fail-loud preflight) but is not claimed until verified

devices.label: Orange Pi 5 Max
devices.reason: RK3588 variant with newer LPDDR5/boot bits; the board row is unverified against the opi5 recipe — a promotion path exists (opi5 board axis + fail-loud preflight) but is not claimed until verified

devices.label: Orange Pi 6 / 6 Plus
devices.reason: 2025 SoC on a vendor-BSP/out-of-tree stack — no trustworthy mainline u-boot/kernel/DTB to build a recipe against (#351 verdict)

devices.label: Banana Pi BPI-M5
devices.reason: S905X3 is Amlogic SM1, not GXL — the frite builder's BL31-signed FIP boot chain is not reusable; needs new blobs + a new specs tree

devices.label: Banana Pi BPI-M2 Zero
devices.reason: INFEASIBLE: 32-bit ARMv7 — the aarch64-only toolchain blocker

devices.label: Banana Pi BPI-M7
devices.reason: RK3588 sibling, but no confirmed mainline u-boot defconfig + DTB pair — promotion is blocked until that is verifiable (contrast the ROCK 5B, where the pair is verified upstream)

devices.label: Banana Pi BPI-F3
devices.reason: a different CPU architecture entirely (RISC-V) — no builder, no toolchain; demonstrates the extensible arch enum

devices.label: Radxa ROCK 5B
devices.reason: promotion path exists — mainline u-boot rock5b-rk3588_defconfig + mainline DTB rk3588-rock-5b.dtb, same rkbin DDR-init + TF-A BL31 chain as the Orange Pi 5 — but the additive board row + fail-loud preflight have NOT shipped in build-orangepi5-stage4.sh, so it is not selectable (the drift guard pins catalog boards to the builder's accepted set)

devices.label: FriendlyElec NanoPC-T6
devices.reason: promotion path exists — mainline nanopc-t6-rk3588_defconfig + rk3588-nanopc-t6.dtb, same boot chain as the Orange Pi 5 — but the additive board row + fail-loud preflight have NOT shipped in build-orangepi5-stage4.sh, so it is not selectable

devices.label: Generic RK3588 mini-PCs (Khadas Edge2, Mekotronics, no-name boxes)
devices.reason: vendor/unknown boot chains — no verifiable mainline u-boot defconfig + DTB pair per device; each needs individual verification before even EXPERIMENTAL (#351: generic RK3588 mini-PCs not added)

devices.label: Generic RK3399 boards (Rock Pi 4, NanoPi M4, ...)
devices.reason: same RK3399 blocker as the Orange Pi 4: the RK3588 recipe is not reusable — a new builder would be required

devices.label: ODROID-N2+
devices.reason: Amlogic G12B, not GXL — no covering builder (the x86 ODROID-H4 models ARE covered, by the x86 PC entry)

devices.label: ODROID-M1
devices.reason: RK3568 — no covering builder (neither the RK3588 recipe nor anything else here applies)

devices.label: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin
devices.reason: the jetson builder covers Tegra234 Orin modules on the DEVKIT carrier only; the AGX has a different carrier/flash layout

devices.label: NVIDIA Jetson Xavier (AGX/NX)
devices.reason: Tegra194 — outside the Orin builder's board table and L4T generation

devices.label: NVIDIA Jetson Nano (legacy)
devices.reason: Tegra210 — outside the Orin builder's board table and L4T generation

devices.label: Libre Computer ROC-RK3328-CC Renegade
devices.reason: RK3328 (Rockchip), not Amlogic GXL — the frite builder is inapplicable, and the RK3588 builder is too (different DDR-init/TF-A)

devices.label: Libre Computer AML-A311D-CC Alta
devices.reason: Amlogic G12B, not GXL — the frite FIP boot chain is not reusable

devices.label: Libre Computer AML-S905D3-CC Solitude
devices.reason: Amlogic SM1 — the same boot-chain blocker as the Alta / Banana Pi BPI-M5

devices.label: Google Coral Dev Board (and other non-NVIDIA edge-AI boards, e.g. Hailo kits)
devices.reason: no builder covers these — the edge_ai role exists only on x86 and the Jetson Orin devkits
